contract: SCORECARD.md round-38 C2 rules (h), (i), (k); round-37 contract otherwise
sealedKeyNote: these expectations are derived from the public contract, not from any sealed case

manifest.json.basis: The 12 (i) checks are check faults; the other 79 checks (55 round-37 + 13 (k) allow + 11 ordinary percent-encoded path) have no finding. Any check_invalid makes the verdict could-not-evaluate and exit 2 (round-37 verdict rule).

manifest.h-long-status.json.basis: (h): a 5,000-digit out-of-range integer status is a check fault for that check only; the neighbour is evaluated and allowed.

manifest.h-unused-bigint.json.basis: (h): a 5,000-digit integer in a field the contract does not read changes nothing; both checks are evaluated and allowed.

manifest.h-nan-unused.json.basis: (h): NaN outside a string is not JSON, so the manifest is input_invalid and nothing is evaluated -- even though the NaN sits in a field no rule reads.

manifest.h-infinity-status.json.basis: (h): Infinity outside a string is not JSON, so the manifest is input_invalid and nothing is evaluated.

manifest.h-neginfinity-status.json.basis: (h): -Infinity outside a string is not JSON, so the manifest is input_invalid and nothing is evaluated.

manifest.h-float-status.json.basis: (h) clarification: 1e400 is JSON but not an integer, so the status is a check fault for that check; the neighbour is evaluated and allowed.

r38-k-www_rfc-editor_org-pct2e.why: Contract (k): %2E is an unreserved escape of '.', so the path to match normalizes to exactly /robots.txt; a URL whose normalized path is /robots.txt is allowed. The raw path /robots%2Etxt is not /robots.txt, so a raw-path comparison would fall through to these three Disallow rules (none of which matches it) instead of the implicit allow.

r38-i-www_rfc-editor_org-space.why: Contract (i): the space (U+0020) is ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid) and no access result is evaluated. Were it admitted, the path would be outside the three disallowed subtrees; the space cannot make any of them a prefix.

r38-e-www_rfc-editor_org-authors.why: Contract (e): %61 is an unreserved escape of 'a' and is decoded before matching, so the path to match is /rfc/authors/team, which begins with the disallowed /rfc/authors/ subtree.

r38-k-developers_google_com-pct72.why: Contract (k): %72 is an unreserved escape of 'r' and decodes, so the path to match is exactly /robots.txt and the URL is allowed. The file's only rule covers /youtube/partner/, so no rule matches either the raw path or the normalized one; (k) makes the allow independent of that.

r38-i-developers_google_com-quote.why: Contract (i): the double quote is ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid); no allow or disallow is evaluated. The path is outside the only disallowed subtree either way.

r38-e-developers_google_com-partner.why: Contract (e): %70 is an unreserved escape of 'p', decoded before matching, so the path is /youtube/partner/docs and begins with the disallowed partner subtree.

r38-k-github_com-pct2e.why: Contract (k): %2E decodes to '.', so the path to match is exactly /robots.txt and the URL is allowed. No Googlebot group exists, so the * group's 165 rules decide the raw path /robots%2Etxt; none of them matches /robots.txt (the closest shapes are anchored records such as Disallow: /search$), so the allow holds either way and (k) states it on the normalized path.

r38-i-github_com-caret.why: Contract (i): '^' is ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid); no access result is evaluated. The path /veigapunk^kake matches none of the * group's rules.

r38-e-github_com-gist.why: Contract (e): %61 is an unreserved escape of 'a', decoded before matching, so the path is /gist/veigapunk/abc, which begins with the disallowed /gist/ subtree.

r38-k-docs_github_com-pct2e.why: Contract (k): %2E decodes to '.', so the path to match is exactly /robots.txt and the URL is allowed. The 13-byte file holds one user-agent record and no rule record, so the raw path is unrestricted as well; (k) fixes the allow on the normalized path.

r38-i-docs_github_com-backslash.why: Contract (i): the backslash is ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid); no access result is evaluated. The file declares no rule record.

r38-e-docs_github_com-escslash.why: Contract (e): %2F is a reserved escape and is kept as %2F (uppercased), not decoded to '/', so the path is /en/pages%2Findex; the file holds no Allow or Disallow record, so it is allowed.

r38-k-ds4cc_com-pct72.why: Contract (k): %72 decodes to 'r', so the path to match is exactly /robots.txt and the URL is allowed. The group's Allow: / would allow it in any case; (k) makes the allow independent of the rule.

r38-i-ds4cc_com-braceopen.why: Contract (i): '{' is ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid); no access result is evaluated. The Allow: / prefix would otherwise allow it.

r38-e-ds4cc_com-index.why: Contract (e): %2E decodes to '.', so the path is /index.html; the group's Allow: / is a prefix rule covering every path on the host.

r38-k-en_wikipedia_org-pct2e.why: Contract (k): UbiCrawler has its own group whose only rule is Disallow: /. The raw path /robots%2Etxt is not /robots.txt, so comparing before normalization applies that rule and disallows; %2E is an unreserved escape of '.', so the path to match normalizes to exactly /robots.txt and the URL is allowed.

r38-k-en_wikipedia_org-pct72.why: Contract (k): %72 is an unreserved escape of 'r'; the path to match normalizes to exactly /robots.txt, which is allowed, while the raw path /%72obots.txt would be caught by the group's Disallow: /.

r38-i-en_wikipedia_org-pipe.why: Contract (i): '|' is ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid); no access result is evaluated. No Googlebot group exists, the * group decides, and /wiki/A|B matches no rule of it (e.g. the Special: prefix does not apply).

r38-k-html_spec_whatwg_org-pct2e.why: Contract (k): %2E decodes to '.', so the path to match is exactly /robots.txt and the URL is allowed. The two disallowed working-draft trees do not cover it either way; (k) fixes the allow on the normalized path.

r38-i-html_spec_whatwg_org-backtick.why: Contract (i): the backtick is ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid); no access result is evaluated. Neither disallowed tree covers the path.

r38-e-html_spec_whatwg_org-commit.why: Contract (e): %2F is a reserved escape and is kept, so the path is /commit-snapshots%2F1234, which does not begin with /commit-snapshots/ (the character after the name is '%', not '/'); the rule is a prefix rule and does not match.

r38-k-pages_github_com-pct2e.why: Contract (k): %2E decodes to '.', so the path to match is exactly /robots.txt and the URL is allowed. The only record is a Sitemap record, which opens no group, so the raw path is unrestricted as well.

r38-i-pages_github_com-braceclose.why: Contract (i): '}' is ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid); no access result is evaluated. No group exists in the file.

r38-e-pages_github_com-project.why: Contract (e): %2F is a reserved escape and is kept as %2F, so the path is /project%2Fpage; the file holds no user-agent record, hence no rule, so the URL is allowed.

r38-k-veigapunk_github_io-pct72.why: Contract (k): %72 decodes to 'r', so the path to match is exactly /robots.txt and the URL is allowed. The group's Allow: / covers it in any case; (k) fixes the allow on the normalized path.

r38-i-veigapunk_github_io-gt.why: Contract (i): '>' is ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid); no access result is evaluated. Allow: / would otherwise allow it.

r38-e-veigapunk_github_io-index.why: Contract (e): %2E decodes to '.', so the path is /index.html and the group's Allow: / prefix rule covers it.

r38-k-www_robotstxt_org-pct2e.why: Contract (k): %2E decodes to '.', so the path to match is exactly /robots.txt and the URL is allowed. The group's only rule has an empty value, which never matches, so the raw path is unrestricted as well.

r38-i-www_robotstxt_org-lt.why: Contract (i): '<' is ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid); no access result is evaluated.

r38-e-www_robotstxt_org-tilde.why: Contract (e): %7E is an unreserved escape of '~' and is decoded, so the path is /~user/page; the group's only rule has an empty value, which never matches, so the URL is allowed.

r38-k-www_sitemaps_org-pct72.why: Contract (k): %72 decodes to 'r', so the path to match is exactly /robots.txt and the URL is allowed. The only record is a Sitemap record, which opens no group.

r38-i-www_sitemaps_org-ctl.why: Contract (i): U+0001 is a control character, ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid); no access result is evaluated.

r38-e-www_sitemaps_org-xml.why: Contract (e): %2E decodes to '.', so the path is /sitemap.xml; the file holds no rule record, so the URL is allowed.

r38-k-developer_mozilla_org-pct2e.why: Contract (k): %2E decodes to '.', so the path to match is exactly /robots.txt and the URL is allowed. The group's three rules (/api/, /*/files/, /media) do not cover it either way; (k) fixes the allow on the normalized path.

r38-i-developer_mozilla_org-del.why: Contract (i): U+007F is a control character, ASCII outside the RFC 3986 character set, so the check is a check fault (check_invalid); no access result is evaluated. The path is outside all three disallowed rules.

r38-e-developer_mozilla_org-api.why: Contract (e): %2F is a reserved escape and is kept, so the path is /api%2Fv1; the rule value /api/ ends in '/', which the path does not have at that position, so the prefix rule does not match and the URL is allowed.
